name: Leveling
description: Members earn XP for chatting and talking in voice. Level ups are announced and a live leaderboard sits in a channel.

form.enabledHelp: Members start earning XP right away. Bots never earn XP.
form.rules: {min}–{max} XP per message (at most once a minute) and {voice} XP per minute in voice while at least one other person is there. Deafened members and the AFK channel earn nothing.
form.ignoredHelp: Text or voice channels, or whole categories. Threads follow their channel.

announceModesHelp.current: Level ups from voice go to the channel below. Without one they stay quiet.
announceModesHelp.channel: Every level up goes to the channel below.
announceModesHelp.off: Members still level up, there is just no message.

form.title: Title
form.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default text in the server language.
form.mentionHelp: Pings the member above the embed so they get a notification.
form.leaderboardHelp: A message with the top members that ShifuBot keeps up to date. Leave the channel empty for no panel.
form.intervalHelp: The panel is only edited when something changed, so a short interval is fine.

leaderboard.title: {server} leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: Nobody has XP yet. Start chatting!

rank.title: {username}'s rank
rank.disabled: Leveling is turned off on this server.

status.noAnnounceChannel: Pick a channel for level up messages.
status.channelMissing: A selected channel no longer exists. Choose another one.
status.panelMissing: The leaderboard is not posted. Save, or post it again below.

panel.failed: Settings saved, but the leaderboard could not be updated: {error}
panel.help: Use this if someone deleted the leaderboard message.

top.title: Top members
top.hint: The top 25 of this server. Members who left are hidden.
top.resetBody: Every member of this server goes back to level 0. This cannot be undone.

preview.levelUpHint: Shown with your name and level 5.
preview.leaderboardHint: With the real top members of this server.

setup.title: Leveling
setup.description: Reward active members with XP and levels. Fine tune messages and the leaderboard later on the Leveling page.
